title: Recording: Alibi by Ringo Starr | 1982
content:
Startling Studios, Ascot
Producers: Joe Walsh, Russ Ballard
Engineer: Jim Nipar

Ringo Starr recorded ‘Alibi’ for his ninth studio album, Old Wave, on 7 March 1982.

‘Alibi’ was the first song to be recorded for the album, with the backing track laid down at Startling Studios in Starr’s Tittenhurst Park mansion. Along with ‘Hopeless’ and ‘Going Down’, it was one of three songs on the album co-written by Starr and co-producer Joe Walsh.
